def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    halfturn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [list(grid[r]) + cw[r] for r in range(n)] + [ccw[r] + halfturn[r] for r in range(n)]
